sections.title: Higher-Register Conditionals
sections.content: Formal, legal agreements replace casual *ha* with elevated conditional conjunctions: *amennyiben* ('in the event that / in so far as'), *feltéve, hogy...* ('provided that...'), *abban az esetben, ha...* ('in the case that...').

items.spanish: Amennyiben bármelyik fél megszegi a megállapodást, kártérítést köteles fizetni.
items.english: In the event that either party breaches the agreement, they are obliged to pay damages.

items.spanish: A szerződés érvényes, feltéve, hogy mindkét fél aláírásával hitelesíti.
items.english: The contract is valid, provided that both parties authenticate it with their signatures.
